data.body: [P2] Bind each callback leaf to its context phase. The STARTED and FAILED leaves constrain only their parent's name and operation ID, so either context segment satisfies both parent expectations. Moving the STARTED leaf beneath the FAILED context and retiming it before the terminal leaf still satisfies counts, ordering, links, and containment. Case 25 therefore passes without a callback leaf in Invocation 1. Require the corresponding `durable.operation.status` on each parent, apply the same constraint to the barrier callbacks, and add a regression that moves only the leaf into the wrong phase.
